scope: Ordinary-map chat routing through Map and World, not certification of official whole-game parity.

history.finding: World chat has broadcast the original ACK since the first port. Replaced only that handler body.
Preserve protected lists and existing party/corps/social state. SendChat still checks ProtectedChat.
Preserve Map chat bans and sender-name rejection; World also checks current name/key/main route and both stored ban forms.
Peer TLS and authorization before World dispatch unchanged.

implemented: Near chat applies faction/aid, meeting-lobby/room and Broa unit-3 exceptions. Existing local grids preserve distance/map/channel scope.
Local whispers resolve ID then name, with faction eligibility, protected lists, and recipient-name echo.

World translates player ACK to recipient REQ packets; party, guild, tactics and corps recipients come from authoritative membership, never a client-supplied foreign group. Duplicate tactics recipients are suppressed.

Remote whispers resolve target ID or case-insensitive name, check effective factions/peace countries and echo the recipient name on the sender main route. Missing recipients remain silent, matching ordinary native whisper behaviour.

Show/map chat fans out to Map peers with faction/block filtering at recipients; Show requires the sender name and matching text length. World announcements continue through the existing event producer.
Operator display derives from TOPERATORTABLE. Whisper to the localized operator alias reaches same-base-country online operators; no available operator returns the native framed offline message.
Sender key/name/main server, current identity, bans, allowed groups and 1024-character bounds are enforced. Clients cannot originate reserved World/operator groups.
intentional_integrity_extensions: Validate all World sender keys/main routes and derive group membership, including guild/tactics, rather than trusting the native target ID.
Derive operator display from the loaded roster and validate actual current recipient objects.
Exclude loading/secondary Map sessions from chat delivery.

validation.platform: Isolated Linux .NET 10 SDK; source read-only. General Map DB tests remain gated; World operator loader was checked separately against live SQL.

legacy_test_change: EndToEndCharEnterTests now expects MW_CHAT_REQ rather than the old no-op ACK echo. Its legacy CHARDATA fixture lacks a name, so it explicitly seeds the canonical name before authenticated chat; production ENTERSVR_ACK provides it.
remaining_verification: Real-client multi-player chat journeys and reconnect/channel-transfer cases remain pending.
Separate native BR_COMPILE_MODE and BOW_COMPILE_MODE match-server chat restrictions require those gameplay servers, which this ordinary-map port does not implement.
Existing wire string encoding was preserved. Locale/diacritic behaviour still needs real-client verification.
No deployment or Git commit was performed for this source slice.

current_deployment.note: Earlier implementation/validation notes retain their historical scope. Current cumulative source is deployed; deployment does not certify whole-game or full gameplay restart parity.
